notes: Normalized from screenshots (ground truth) + raw profile. The 'white' is NOT #ffffff anywhere: a single warm bone tone #e9ebdf (rgb 233,235,223) serves as primary text, the inverse light surface (prompt card / badge), AND the hairline border color — one ink doing three jobs. Page is warm near-black #151515; raised dark surface #242424. Borders are mostly that bone at 12% alpha (near-invisible structure on dark). Weights collapse to a 380/400 band only — hierarchy is scale-driven, never weight-driven; 380 is a real fractional weight on the Saans variable font, normalized in spirit to ~regular. Signature ease cubic-bezier(0.72,0,0.12,1) (snappy, fast-out) at 600ms dominates the profile. Single chromatic accent is a muted azure #518dd2 used almost only on the hero send button + links; everything else is achromatic warm-neutral. Radius 36px is the large prompt-card/hero-pill family; 4px is small controls; 9999px pills. The 0 68px 116px/0.35 shadow is the extreme focal-card elevation that lifts the prompt card off the 3D screenshot field. Hero background is a cool-slate (#2c3748) to warm-umber (#461e15) gradient over #151515. Type scale rounded to a sane ramp from observed 12/14/16/18/32/48/60/72px.
